post.description: Creates a single geofence from a WKT (Well-Known Text) geometry plus name and description. The WKT is parsed and normalized to a MultiPolygon with ring winding corrected for MongoDB 2dsphere storage. Expects standard WKT coordinate order (longitude latitude). The owning client is derived from the authenticated principal, never from the request body.

post.summary: Create a geofence from a center point and radius
post.description: Creates a single circular geofence from a center latitude/longitude and a radius in meters. The server expands the circle into a polygon and stores it as a MultiPolygon with ring winding corrected for MongoDB 2dsphere indexing. Coordinates are WGS 84 decimal degrees. The owning client is derived from the authenticated principal, never from the request body.

400.description: Missing or out-of-range coordinates or radius

403.description: Authenticated but plan role not permitted

post.summary: Import geofences from a GeoJSON FeatureCollection
post.description:
Accepts a GeoJSON FeatureCollection and creates one geofence per feature.

Every geofence in the request is assigned the `category` query parameter — a free-form, customer-defined grouping (e.g. `corridor`, `depot`, `service-area`) usable as a filter when listing fences or computing dwell. To import fences with different categories, send one request per category.

For each feature, the geofence's name and description are read from the feature's `properties` using the `nameKey` and `descriptionKey` query parameters (defaults: `name`, `description`). If `suffixNameKey` is supplied, that property's value is appended to the name as `{name} - {suffix}`; a feature whose suffix property is missing or blank is stored with its name alone. The suffix is useful when a source file reuses names across features, for example one route name with an outbound and an inbound polygon.

The name, suffix, and description keys are removed from `properties`; every remaining property (e.g. `routeId`, `stopIds`, `color`) is stored verbatim on the geofence and returned with it, but is not queryable. A `category` property on a feature is not read — it is stored as an ordinary extra property.

The name property is required on every feature. Description is optional.

Geometry must be a Polygon or MultiPolygon in standard [longitude, latitude] order. It is normalized to a MultiPolygon with ring winding corrected for MongoDB 2dsphere indexing. Other geometry types are rejected.

The owning client is derived from the authenticated principal, never from the body.

parameters.name: nameKey
parameters.description: Property key holding the geofence name. The property itself is required on every feature.

parameters.name: suffixNameKey
parameters.description: Property key holding an optional name suffix. When set, the stored name is `{name} - {suffix}`. Omit for no suffix.

parameters.name: descriptionKey
parameters.description: Property key holding the geofence description. Optional.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category assigned to every geofence in this FeatureCollection — a free-form grouping such as `corridor`, `depot`, or `service-area`. Required.

requestBody.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Each feature becomes one geofence. With `category=depot&suffixNameKey=direction`, the example is stored as `Depot North - Gate A` in category `depot`.

400.description: Malformed GeoJSON, unsupported geometry type, invalid ring, a feature missing its name property, or missing `category` parameter

value.title: Invalid geofence geometry
value.detail: features[2]: linear ring needs >= 4 positions when closed

403.description: Authenticated but plan role not permitted

post.description: Submits a real-time position update for a tracked asset. The asset `name` and `type` must match an existing entry in your Nearsight client configuration.

requestBody.description: Asset position snapshot. `name`, `type`, `timestamp`, `latitude`, and `longitude` are required.

400.description: Invalid payload — missing required fields or out-of-range values

403.description: API key does not have sufficient tier for this endpoint

post.summary: Ingest a batch of asset position snapshots

requestBody.description: Asset position snapshots. Per asset, `name`, `type`, `timestamp`, `latitude`, and `longitude` are required.

get.summary: List geofences for the authenticated client
get.description: Returns the name and description of every geofence owned by the authenticated client. Geometry is not included — use a geofence's name with the other endpoints to act on it. Scope is derived from the principal, so a client only ever sees its own geofences; the list is empty when the client has none.

403.description: Authenticated but plan role not permitted

delete.description: Deletes the named geofence belonging to the authenticated client. The name is resolved within the caller's scope, so one client cannot delete another's geofence.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the geofence to delete, unique within the client's scope.

403.description: Authenticated but plan role not permitted

404.description: No geofence with that name for this client

delete.summary: Delete a tracked asset by name and type
delete.description: Removes a single tracked asset scoped to the authenticated client. The client ID is derived from the security principal, so assets belonging to other clients are never affected.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the asset to delete

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type the asset is classified under

403.description: Authenticated client lacks a required role

404.description: No asset found for the given name and type under this client

GeoFenceWkt.description: Defines a geofence from a WKT (Well-Known Text) geometry plus metadata. The server parses the WKT, normalizes it to a MultiPolygon, and corrects ring winding for 2dsphere storage. Coordinates are WGS 84 in standard WKT order: longitude first, then latitude.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the geofence.

wkt.description: Geofence geometry as a WKT string. Must be a POLYGON or MULTIPOLYGON in standard (longitude latitude) coordinate order. Polygon rings should be closed (first point repeated as last).

radiusInMeters.description: Radius in meters from the center point.

TrackedAsset.description: Real-time position snapshot of a tracked asset reported to Nearsight.

name.description: Unique identifier of the asset within its fleet. Must match the asset name registered in Nearsight.

type.description: Asset classification as registered in Nearsight. Must match an existing type in the client configuration.

timestamp.description: UTC time of the GPS fix as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. This is the device recording time, not the ingestion time.

latitude.description: WGS-84 latitude in decimal degrees. Valid range: -90.0 (South Pole) to 90.0 (North Pole).

longitude.description: WGS-84 longitude in decimal degrees. Valid range: -180.0 (West) to 180.0 (East).

bearing.description: Direction of travel in decimal degrees, clockwise from true north (0–360). Unreliable below ~5 km/h. Null if unavailable or stationary.

speed.description: Current speed of the asset in km/h. Must be zero or positive. Null if unavailable.

status.description: Operational status of the asset at the time of this report. Null is treated as unknown.

information.description: Freeform field for vendor-specific or supplemental data. Accepts plain text or serialized JSON. Stored but not indexed by Nearsight.

GeoFenceResponse.description: Geofence details returned to the client

ApiKey.description: API key from your signup email. Used to authenticate requests. Keep it secret. This is NOT the API Secret Key.
ApiKey.name: X-API-Key
